ValidationRule.description: Only fires if Scheme Holder Type is set. Requires the matching field for that level to be filled in too.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Scheme_Holder_Type__c))), OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Scheme_Holder_Type__c, 'Distributor'), ISBLANK(Distributor__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Scheme_Holder_Type__c, 'Hub'), ISBLANK(TEXT(Hub__c))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Scheme_Holder_Type__c, 'Region'), ISBLANK(Region__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Scheme_Holder_Type__c, 'Retailer'), ISBLANK(Account__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The field matching the selected Scheme Holder Type must be filled in (Distributor level needs Distributor, Hub level needs Hub, Region level needs Region, Retailer level needs Account).
